GitHub mitcad/Mitcad#741's third design (mitcad#2582; opened with --open, never committed; tools/cli/fillet-whole-rims-reported-test.cmake): an annulus 40 across with a bore of 20, 10 high (Extrude1 F9, Body1 F9.b0), its four rims rounded with 5 by Fillet1 (F10, d22) in one constant set. Built before 0.1 % smaller with a warning; now a torus about the annulus's axis, its tube circle of radius 15, its section 5: 750 pi^2, no planar or cylindrical face left, without a note.
